purpose: Teach: チャイナ/ウエスト/浦和/三島/ジェフ/クラーク/コロンビア/セントラル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチャイナドレスの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to read you the picture book about the qipao.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Soft opening. Slight lift at the end—sharing something sweet about his father. Voice carries quiet fondness for watching them together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ウエストを引き締める運動してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been doing exercises to tighten my waist.
lines.style: Small, serious voice. Earnest concentration on what he's telling her. Not quite looking for approval, but wanting to be heard. Slight breathiness—he's proud of this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが浦和の試合に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to take you to the Urawa match.
lines.style: Same warm, gentle delivery as before. A touch more excitement this time—she knows this one will matter to him. Delighted in her own quiet way.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと三島由紀夫の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Yukio Mishima.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick pace. He's sharing something that felt grown-up and special. Small wonder in his tone—pride that his dad shared this with him, not just telling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェフのギター演奏を聴かせて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played guitar for you—Jeff's song.
lines.style: Tender, reflective. A little slower than before. This one matters—live music, his father's effort. Voice softens on 'played.' Slight trailing-off, like she's savouring the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとクラーク博士のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about Dr. Clark.
lines.style: Earnest, attentive child voice. Not shouting his news—delivering it carefully because it mattered. Calm pride. He listened well and he's telling it right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコロンビアの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you the Colombia picture book.
lines.style: Warmly reflective. Gentle, unhurried. She's been doing this a while—noticing, gathering these small moments. Voice has a soft, almost maternal quality. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとセントラルパークの写真集見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at photos of Central Park together.
lines.style: Warm, glowing closing. Sho's voice is bright but quieter now—intimate. He's sharing something precious and specific. Slight breathiness at the end—contentment, not urgency.
